mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals strong consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production (INDPRO above 105.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overheating and potential monetary tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when FEDFUNDS > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 100.0.
